analysis.rationale: Single-step motion blur severity 1. Blur proven by gm_ratio=0.629 + spectral_slope_ratio=1.101; motion supported by residual_anisotropy=1.661 (near the 1.7 threshold) and by PSNR ceiling: motion:1 reaches 28.84dB on pair0 and 37.66dB on support pair3 (radius-5 kernel, lucky angle), whereas gaussian/glass variants are angle-independent and cap at ~24dB; angle-robust texture signals (zero_crossing_density 0-2%, hf_lf_ratio 0-1%, unique_RGB 0-3%) match target across all 5 pairs. Severity=1 vs 2: motion:2 best draw 26.19dB and systematically over-blurs (zcd 9-11% low), versus pair3 37.66dB near-exact for radius-5. Glass DT (glass_score=0.70) is the documented FP; gaussian alternative retained. Noise excluded: peeled residual structured (spatial_corr=0.984) and x_distortion minimum noise sigma=12.75 >> measured 1.24; §B extreme_pct=58% falls under the >50%+sigma<5 false-positive rule. Compression excluded: block_boundary=1.016 (<1.1), dct_zero stable. Global excluded: variance_ratio=0.694/chroma=0.794 explained by blur smoothing; adding saturate_weaken_HSV/YCrCb, contrast_weaken_scale/stretch each reduced PSNR (23.7->19.0->10.9) and broke unique-color match (up to +113). Brightness excluded: mean_shift=-0.4/255 vs >=25.5 minimum shift. Verdict UNCERTAIN rather than LIKELY because PSNR 30-40dB (motion angle is random at generation; >40dB unattainable without angle luck).
